title: Palantir股价因Nvidia担忧连续三日下跌，Phillip Securities上调目标价至248美元
originalTitle: Palantir stock slides 4% on Nvidia jitters as Phillip Securities lifts target to $248
summary: Palantir Technologies周一股价下跌4%（现价$160-$162），为连续第三日收跌。同一日Phillip Securities将目标价上调至$248，Barclays和Deutsche Bank也有类似评级。

story.title: Phillip Securities上调Palantir目标价至$248，股价因Nvidia担忧连续三日下跌

author: Vivian Nguyen
